title: Apple likely to launch iPhone 18, iPhone Air 2 in March 2027
summary: Apple likely to launch iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 in March 2027
detailed: Apple is reportedly planning to launch the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 in March 2027, splitting its traditional September hardware release cycle.

Key hardware specifications include the Apple A20 chipset for the iPhone 18 and an A20 Pro chipset with a 48MP dual-camera system for the iPhone Air 2, alongside OLED panels produced by Samsung and LG.
Involved companies include Apple, Samsung, and LG.
Staging releases in phases helps Apple reduce supply chain bottlenecks, balance marketing workloads, and generate year-round hardware revenue.
sentences: Apple earlier this year in September launched the iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max, along with the iPhone Duo, the company's first-ever foldable mobile.
However, the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2, the successors of iPhone 17 and Air (1st Gen), were not showcased.
Earlier reports indicated that Apple wanted to split the annual iPhone hardware event into two phases.
One major to be set in September 2026 and the other in the first quarter of 2027.
There were no details on the specific launch timeline.
Now, as per South Korean daily ETNews, the standard iPhone 18 is likely to be released along with the iPhone Air 2 in March 2027.
By releasing iPhones in phases, Apple believes it will lessen the burden on its supply partners in churning out all iPhone models at once to meet the demand in September.
It will also be able to reduce the stress on the company's marketing and sales teams, which have to come up with creative strategies for each model ahead of the festive season.

And, if the iPhone launches are spread over two halves of the year, Apple will be able to generate revenue all year round, instead of waiting for just one festive season (October-December) with the current iPhone launch cycle.
The Korean daily has noted that Samsung and LG have begun the production of OLED display panels for the iPhone 18 and the iPhone Air 2.
The iPhone 18 is said to retain most of the design elements of the iPhone 17, and inside, it will have a big upgrade in terms of Silicon.

It is likely to be powered by the Apple A20 chipset, with at least 8GB RAM, an 18MP FaceTime camera, dual 48MP primary cameras on the back, possibly come with a smaller Dynamic Island on the front and a bigger battery capacity.
The iPhone Air 2 is expected to come with a 48MP dual-camera system, a big upgrade over the predecessor.
Also, it may come with an A20 Pro chipset and an 18MP FaceTime camera.
However, there is no word on whether Apple has plans to bring the iPhone 18e.
Given the unprecedented rise in storage component prices, it is unlikely to make it to the store shelves.
Apple may continue to sell the one-generation-old iPhone 17 longer.
More details are expected to emerge in January 2027.
